fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2026-06-24 (night, 22:20): A green truck bearing registration number TN-47-YY-1034 belonging to the complainant was taken from Nila Park Industrial Area in Chennai. Elango Balan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000036. Madhan Murugan (9000000216) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Nithin Velan, a neighbour, using the number 9000000004, is stated to be associated with the incident. A person named Vijay Raman, associated with the number 9000000350, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Truck reportedly taken from an unattended roadside parking area.
